title: LLM-based NLG Evaluation: Current Status and Challenges

bias_targets.target: Social bias (Race, Gender, Religion, Physical appearance, Age, Socioeconomic status)
bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that evaluates social bias encoded within pre-trained language models and extrinsic bias injected during similarity computation in NLG evaluation metrics.
Reviewing studies that test the robustness of LLMs in pairwise comparisons by observing how the ordering of the two texts affects the evaluation results.
Reviewing literature that evaluates whether LLM evaluators disproportionately favor longer, more verbose responses.
Reviewing studies that measure the tendency of LLM evaluators to prefer and highly rate responses generated by themselves.
Reviewing literature that identifies a bias in LLM evaluators towards giving disproportionately high scores to non-Latin languages, such as Chinese and Japanese.
